script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The recipe-card joke does not make sense: he says he owns the cards but has never kept them.
“No throne in sight” adds a scene detail the passage does not give.
“The angel's whole answer” was not just “Worship God!” He also told John not to worship him and called himself a fellow servant.
Revelation 21:15 says the angel had the measuring rod to measure the city. Verse 16 says he measured it, so the reference should include verse 16.
“Nobody is counting cups” turns drinking freely into a claim about an unlimited quantity. The verse does not say that.
Calling the warning “not nice” sounds flippant about a serious passage.
The joke about a shorter last line makes the way Scripture is written the joke.
